items.title: 61520_Teddy Edwards oral history interview
items.q: I used to play over there with Vi Redd's father, Alton Redd.

ctx.x: Most of the clubs on Central Avenue and the east side had folded, and things were beginning to move west music-wise. The next big music stop was Western Avenue. And it had places like the Ringside on Washington and Western. I used to play over there with Vi Redd's father, Alton Redd. He used to hire Wardell and me over there to play with them
